source: Kazusa Codon Usage Database (representative published Saccharomyces cerevisiae values)
build: hand-curated representative table, per-thousand codon frequencies
note: These are REPRESENTATIVE published Saccharomyces cerevisiae codon-usage values (Kazusa-style, per-thousand), NOT an authoritative per-genome recount from a specific CDS set. They reflect well-known yeast biases (e.g. strong preference for AGA at Arg and TTG/TTA at Leu). Frequencies are relative usage on a positive scale; only ratios within an amino acid's synonymous group matter for relative adaptiveness and CAI. Do not present these as an exact genome-wide count.
